title: 第14课 · 你看过那个电影吗
subtitle: HSK 2 · Lesson 14 — 你看过那个电影吗 · Have you seen that movie

data.topic: 课文1 · 1. 在教室 — In the classroom

items.py: A: Nǐ kànguo nàge diànyǐng méiyǒu?
items.en: A: Have you seen that film?

items.py: B: Méi kànguo, tīngshuō hěn yǒu yìsi.
items.en: B: No, but I hear it's great.

items.zh: A：那我们下个星期一起去看吧？
items.py: A: Nà wǒmen xià ge xīngqī yìqǐ qù kàn ba?
items.en: A: Shall we go and see it together next week?

items.zh: B：可以，但是我女朋友也想去。
items.py: B: Kěyǐ, dànshì wǒ nǚpéngyou yě xiǎng qù.
items.en: B: OK, but my girlfriend wants to come too.

data.topic: 课文2 · 2. 在办公室 — In the office

items.zh: A：听说你去过中国，还想去吗？
items.py: A: Tīngshuō nǐ qùguo Zhōngguó, hái xiǎng qù ma?
items.en: A: I hear you've been to China. Do you want to go again?

items.zh: B：我虽然去过好几次，但是还想再去玩儿玩儿。
items.py: B: Wǒ suīrán qùguo hǎo jǐ cì, dànshì hái xiǎng zài qù wánr wánr.
items.en: B: I've been several times, but I still want to go again for fun.

items.py: A: Nà wǒmen yìqǐ qù ba.
items.en: A: Then let's go together.

items.zh: B：好啊，到时候我给你打电话。
items.py: B: Hǎo a, dào shíhou wǒ gěi nǐ dǎ diànhuà.
items.en: B: Great, I'll call you when the time comes.

data.topic: 课文3 · 3. 在房间 — In the room

items.py: A: Míngtiān tiānqì zěnmeyàng?
items.en: A: What will the weather be like tomorrow?

items.py: B: Suīrán shì qíngtiān, dànshì hěn lěng.
items.en: B: Sunny, but very cold.

items.py: A: Nà hái néng qù pǎo bù ma?
items.en: A: Can we still go running then?

items.zh: B：可以，但是你自己去吧，我还有很多事情要做。
items.py: B: Kěyǐ, dànshì nǐ zìjǐ qù ba, wǒ hái yǒu hěn duō shìqing yào zuò.
items.en: B: Sure, but go by yourself — I've got a lot to do.

data.topic: 课文4 · 4. 在商店 — In a store

items.zh: A：你在这个商店买过东西没有？
items.py: A: Nǐ zài zhège shāngdiàn mǎiguo dōngxi méiyǒu?
items.en: A: Have you ever bought anything in this shop?

items.zh: B：买过一次，这儿的东西还可以，就是不便宜。
items.py: B: Mǎiguo yí cì, zhèr de dōngxi hái kěyǐ, jiùshì bù piányi.
items.en: B: Once. The things are OK, just not cheap.

items.zh: A：我喜欢这件衣服，但是觉得有点儿贵。
items.py: A: Wǒ xǐhuan zhè jiàn yīfu, dànshì juéde yǒudiǎnr guì.
items.en: A: I like this one, but it's a bit expensive.

items.zh: B：两百块还可以，喜欢就买吧。
items.py: B: Liǎngbǎi kuài hái kěyǐ, xǐhuan jiù mǎi ba.
items.en: B: Two hundred yuan is OK. If you like it, buy it.

data.topic: 语法 · Grammar (结构助词“过”: experience)

items.py: Tāmen láiguo wǒ jiā.
items.en: They've been to my home.

items.py: Wǒ kànguo nàge diànyǐng.
items.en: I've seen that film.

items.py: Wǒ qùguo Zhōngguó.
items.en: I've been to China.

items.py: Wǒ méi(yǒu) kànguo nàge diànyǐng.
items.en: I haven't seen that film.

items.py: Nǐ qùguo Zhōngguó méiyǒu?
items.en: Have you ever been to China?

items.zh: 虽然外面很冷，但是房间里很热。
items.py: Suīrán wàimiàn hěn lěng, dànshì fángjiān li hěn rè.
items.en: Although it's cold outside, it's warm in the room.

items.zh: 虽然汉字很难，但是我很喜欢写汉字。
items.py: Suīrán Hànzì hěn nán, dànshì wǒ hěn xǐhuan xiě Hànzì.
items.en: Although characters are hard, I love writing them.

items.py: Suīrán shì qíngtiān, dànshì hěn lěng.
items.en: Although it's sunny, it's very cold.

data.topic: 语法 · Grammar (动量补语“次”: number of times)

items.py: Wǒmen kànguo sān cì diànyǐng.
items.en: We've been to the cinema three times.

items.py: Tāmen zuòguo yí cì fēijī.
items.en: They've flown once.

items.zh: 我在这个商店买过一次东西。
items.py: Wǒ zài zhège shāngdiàn mǎiguo yí cì dōngxi.
items.en: I've bought something in this shop once.

items.zh: 我们去过三次北京。 / 我们去过北京三次。
items.py: Wǒmen qùguo sān cì Běijīng. / Wǒmen qùguo Běijīng sān cì.
items.en: We've been to Beijing three times (both orders work with places).

items.py: Wǒmen zhǎoguo tā sān cì.
items.en: We looked for him three times (pronoun: 次 after it).

items.py: Tāmen kànguo nàge diànyǐng ma?
items.en: Have they seen that film?

items.zh: 他们想几个人去看电影？
items.py: Tāmen xiǎng jǐ ge rén qù kàn diànyǐng?
items.en: How many of them want to see the film?

items.py: Tāmen xiǎng lái Zhōngguó zuò shénme?
items.en: What do they want to do in China?

items.zh: 为什么她明天不能去跑步？
items.py: Wèi shénme tā míngtiān bù néng qù pǎo bù?
items.en: Why can't she go running tomorrow?

items.zh: 女的觉得这个商店的东西怎么样？
items.py: Nǚ de juéde zhège shāngdiàn de dōngxi zěnmeyàng?
items.en: What does the woman think of this shop's things?

items.zh: 我在北京买过一件很漂亮的衣服。
items.py: Wǒ zài Běijīng mǎiguo yí jiàn hěn piàoliang de yīfu.
items.en: I once bought a very pretty piece of clothing in Beijing.

items.zh: 你以前吃过这种水果吗？
items.py: Nǐ yǐqián chīguo zhè zhǒng shuǐguǒ ma?
items.en: Have you eaten this kind of fruit before?

items.zh: 我去年见过你姐姐一次。
items.py: Wǒ qùnián jiànguo nǐ jiějie yí cì.
items.en: I met your elder sister once last year.

items.zh: 虽然这件衣服很漂亮，但是太贵了，我没钱买。
items.py: Suīrán zhè jiàn yīfu hěn piàoliang, dànshì tài guì le, wǒ méi qián mǎi.
items.en: Although this is pretty, it's too expensive — I can't afford it.
